    word_token_indices = case["word_token_indices"]
    word_scores = case["word_scores"]
    forced_words = case.get("forced_words", [])
    token_budget = case["token_budget"]

    n = len(word_token_indices)
    costs = [len(tokens) for tokens in word_token_indices]
    values = word_scores
    forced_set = set(forced_words)
    forced_cost = sum(costs[i] for i in forced_set)
    remaining = token_budget - forced_cost
    selected = list(forced_set)

    if remaining < 0:
        tokens_used = forced_cost
    else:
        nonforced = [i for i in range(n) if i not in forced_set]
        dp = [float('-inf')] * (remaining + 1)
        dp[0] = 0.0
        choice = [(-1, -1)] * (remaining + 1)
        for idx in nonforced:
            cost_i = costs[idx]
            val_i = values[idx]
            for j in range(remaining, cost_i - 1, -1):
                if dp[j - cost_i] != float('-inf'):
                    new_val = dp[j - cost_i] + val_i
                    if new_val > dp[j]:
                        dp[j] = new_val
                        choice[j] = (j - cost_i, idx)
        best_val = float('-inf')
        best_j = 0
        for j in range(remaining + 1):
            if dp[j] > best_val:
                best_val = dp[j]
                best_j = j
        nonforced_selected = []
        j = best_j
        while choice[j][0] != -1:
            prev_j, idx = choice[j]
            nonforced_selected.append(idx)
            j = prev_j
        selected.extend(nonforced_selected)
        tokens_used = sum(costs[i] for i in selected)

    selected_sorted = sorted(selected)
    retained_token_indices = []
    for idx in selected_sorted:
        retained_token_indices.extend(word_token_indices[idx])

    return {
        "retained_token_indices": retained_token_indices,
        "selected_words": selected_sorted,
        "tokens_used": tokens_used
    }"
}

def solve(case):
    word_token_indices = case["word_token_indices"]
    word_scores = case["word_scores"]
    forced_words = case.get("forced_words", [])  # default empty
    token_budget = case["token_budget"]
    
    n = len(word_token_indices)
    costs = [len(tokens) for tokens in word_token_indices]
    values = word_scores
    forced_set = set(forced_words)
    forced_cost = sum(costs[i] for i in forced_set)
    # Check feasibility: if forced_cost > token_budget, still include forced
    remaining = token_budget - forced_cost
    selected = list(forced_set)
    
    if remaining < 0:
        # forced alone exceed budget, cannot add any more
        tokens_used = forced_cost
    else:
        # Prepare non-forced items
        nonforced = [i for i in range(n) if i not in forced_set]
        # DP
        dp = [float('-inf')] * (remaining + 1)
        dp[0] = 0.0
        choice = [(-1, -1)] * (remaining + 1)  # (prev_cost, item_index)
        for idx in nonforced:
            cost_i = costs[idx]
            val_i = values[idx]
            for j in range(remaining, cost_i - 1, -1):
                if dp[j - cost_i] != float('-inf'):
                    new_val = dp[j - cost_i] + val_i
                    if new_val > dp[j]:
                        dp[j] = new_val
                        choice[j] = (j - cost_i, idx)
        # Find best j
        best_val = float('-inf')
        best_j = 0
        for j in range(remaining + 1):
            if dp[j] > best_val:
                best_val = dp[j]
                best_j = j
        # Backtrack
        nonforced_selected = []
        j = best_j
        while choice[j][0] != -1:
            prev_j, idx = choice[j]
            nonforced_selected.append(idx)
            j = prev_j
        # Add to selected
        selected.extend(nonforced_selected)
        tokens_used = sum(costs[i] for i in selected)
    
    # Now build retained_token_indices in order of word indices
    selected_sorted = sorted(selected)
    retained_token_indices = []
    for idx in selected_sorted:
        retained_token_indices.extend(word_token_indices[idx])
    # Build result
    result = {
        "retained_token_indices": retained_token_indices,
        "selected_words": selected_sorted,
        "tokens_used": tokens_used
    }
    return result
